title: A sprint's goal research story names the goal's open questions, so researched reads their coverage
goal: backlog.py new sprint writes the goal research story's goal with the sprint goal's open questions as numbered questions (or asks the planner for them), so backlog.py researched reads the kb coverage of each instead of printing that the goal names no question

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, subprocess, tempfile, json, glob
T = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp())
ENV = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("GIT_", "KB_COORD"))}
ENV.pop("CLAUDECODE", None)
ENV.update(KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite"), GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1",
           GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t@example.com", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t@example.com")
def g(*a, cwd):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=cwd, env=ENV, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
def tool(*a, ok=(0,)):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=300)
    assert r.returncode in ok, (a, r.returncode, r.stdout[-800:], r.stderr[-800:])
    return r
O, C = os.path.join(T, "origin.git"), os.path.join(T, "clone")
g("init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main", O, cwd=T)
g("clone", "-q", O, C, cwd=T)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog"))
open(os.path.join(C, "backlog.json"), "w").write('{"item_dir": "kb/_self/backlog"}\n')
open(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog", ".keep"), "w").close()
g("add", "-A", cwd=C); g("commit", "-qm", "base", cwd=C)
tool("_tools/backlog.py", "--root", C, "new", "sprint", "--title", "Tidy asks", "--goal", "tidy asks the operator about a leftover; cleanup runs one capped session")
goals = [json.load(open(p)).get("goal", "") for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog", "ST-*.json"))
         if json.load(open(p)).get("goal_research")]
assert goals and "?" in goals[0], ("the goal research story names no question", goals[:1])
